summary: Episode ep_013 covers one continuous sequence across sc_001 and sc_002 (0-118880 ms). Juliana, after pleas from the handcuffed Alexander, enters the frozen blackthorn briars while Clarissa and Gerald mock her from the terrace. She is cut repeatedly, keeps digging, and grips an emerald ring in the soil before the episode cuts to black. Uncertainty: the analysis uses only on-screen event text; the metadata logline and continuity notes were not treated as evidence. The ring's significance, whether it affects Alexander's fate, the family relation implied by Clarissa calling Juliana sister, and Juliana's condition after the cut to black are not established on screen. Gerald's claim that Alexander's freedom lies in the garden is an unverified taunt.

beats.description: The frozen blackthorn garden is shown with wind and brass drone, and the assembled group is established before the briars.
Alexander pleads with Juliana not to enter the thorns; she answers that she must.
Juliana reassures Alexander; he says he would rather face the gallows than watch her hurt herself, while Gerald smirks above.
Juliana vows she will not abandon Alexander, releases his hands and walks toward the briars; the Constable restrains Alexander.
Clarissa and Gerald mock Juliana as she approaches the garden.
Juliana kneels and crawls under the thorns as Alexander strains and calls for her to stop.
Thorns cut Juliana's bare hands deeply while Clarissa and Gerald jeer and Gerald taunts that Alexander's freedom is in the garden.
Juliana drags deeper into the tangle and is snagged and lacerated further; Alexander charges and is grappled back by the Constable.
Juliana digs through frozen dirt with bloodied hands, calling for the ring while Alexander shouts her name.
Juliana finds a metallic object in the frost and closes her hand around an ornate gold ring set with an emerald.
Juliana grimaces in triumph and pain, Alexander watches in terror, and the episode cuts to black on her bloodied fist gripping the ring.

revelations.claim: An ornate gold ring set with a large emerald is half-buried in the frozen soil beneath the blackthorn, and Juliana grasps it.
